cards.name: Sprigatito
cards.description: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

cards.name: Floragato
cards.description: The hardness of Floragato's fur depends on the Pokémon's mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

cards.name: Tarountula
cards.description: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

cards.name: Spidops
cards.description: Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders.

cards.name: Nymble
cards.description: It's highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.

cards.name: Smoliv
cards.description: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

cards.name: Dolliv
cards.description: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

cards.name: Arboliva
cards.description: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

cards.name: Bramblin
cards.description: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.

cards.name: Brambleghast
cards.description: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

cards.name: Capsakid
cards.description: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

cards.name: Scovillain
cards.description: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

cards.name: Rellor
cards.description: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.

cards.name: Wo-Chien
cards.description: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.

cards.name: Fuecoco
cards.description: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.

cards.name: Crocalor
cards.description: The valve in Crocalor's flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

cards.name: Skeledirge
cards.description: Skeledirge's gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Charcadet
cards.description: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

cards.name: Chi-Yu
cards.description: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.

cards.name: Quaxly
cards.description: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

cards.name: Quaxwell
cards.description: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

cards.name: Quaquaval
cards.description: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.

cards.name: Wiglett
cards.description: Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.

cards.name: Wugtrio
cards.description: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.

cards.name: Finizen
cards.description: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

cards.name: Palafin
cards.description: This hero of the ocean swims at a speed of 50 knots and saves drowning people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Cetoddle
cards.description: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

cards.name: Cetitan
cards.description: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

cards.name: Veluza
cards.description: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.

cards.name: Dondozo
cards.description: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.

cards.name: Tatsugiri
cards.description: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

cards.name: Frigibax
cards.description: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

cards.name: Arctibax
cards.description: It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax’s strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.

cards.name: Baxcalibur
cards.description: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

cards.name: Pawmi
cards.description: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

cards.name: Pawmo
cards.description: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

cards.name: Pawmot
cards.description: Pawmot's fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

cards.name: Tadbulb
cards.description: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.

cards.name: Wattrel
cards.description: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they're a popular delicacy.

cards.name: Kilowattrel
cards.description: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There's hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

cards.name: Miraidon
cards.description: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

cards.name: Fidough
cards.description: The yeast in Fidough's breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.

cards.name: Dachsbun
cards.description: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

cards.name: Ceruledge
cards.description: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon's evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.

cards.name: Rabsca
cards.description: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.

cards.name: Flittle
cards.description: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

cards.name: Espathra
cards.description: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

cards.name: Greavard
cards.description: This friendly Pokémon doesn't like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

cards.name: Houndstone
cards.description: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn't like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

cards.name: Gimmighoul
cards.description: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.description: It is extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.description: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

cards.name: Annihilape
cards.description: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

cards.name: Paldean Tauros
cards.description: This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed, is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and its fierce disposition.

cards.name: Toedscool
cards.description: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.

cards.name: Toedscruel
cards.description: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

cards.name: Klawf
cards.description: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.

cards.name: Ting-Lu
cards.description: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

cards.name: Koraidon
cards.description: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.

cards.name: Paldean Wooper
cards.description: It's dangerous for Wooper to travel alone. They line up in groups of three or four and help each other as they walk around the wetlands.

cards.name: Paldean Clodsire
cards.description: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.

cards.name: Lokix
cards.description: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can't stay in this mode for long.

cards.name: Maschiff
cards.description: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

cards.name: Mabosstiff
cards.description: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

cards.name: Shroodle
cards.description: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

cards.name: Grafaiai
cards.description: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

cards.name: Bombirdier
cards.description: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

cards.name: Tinkatink
cards.description: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it's satisfied with the result.

cards.name: Tinkatuff
cards.description: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other's hammers by smashing them together.

cards.name: Tinkaton
cards.description: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

cards.name: Varoom
cards.description: The steel section is Varoom's actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

cards.name: Revavroom
cards.description: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

cards.name: Orthworm
cards.description: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.

cards.name: Lechonk
cards.description: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.

cards.name: Oinkologne
cards.description: It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.

cards.name: Tandemaus
cards.description: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

cards.name: Maushold
cards.description: The little one just appeared one day. They all live together like a family, but the relationship between the three is still unclear.

cards.name: Squawkabilly
cards.description: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they're out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

cards.name: Cyclizar
cards.description: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider's body heat warms Cyclizar's back and lifts the Pokémon's spirit.

cards.name: Flamigo
cards.description: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

cards.name: Fuecoco
cards.description: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.

cards.name: Meowscarada
cards.description: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

cards.name: Gholdengo
cards.description: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.
